# Timer:reset

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.4.10</span></div>

Reset the timer.

```lua
timer:reset()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
timer = model.getTimer(0)
timer:reset()
```
